issues.description: Method order violation: layout() (line 35) appears before requirements() (line 38). The standard order per code style rule CS-R3 is: export_sources → requirements → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info. The 'layout' and 'requirements' methods are swapped.
issues.fix_suggestion: Swap the two methods so requirements() comes before layout(), matching the standard order: def requirements(self): ... then def layout(self): ...

issues.description: Two documentation inconsistencies in notes.md: (1) Dependency section says 'openssl/系统版本' (system version) but conanfile.py correctly requires 'openssl/3.5.6' from Conan — notes should say 'openssl/3.5.6'. (2) Build command example uses 'make ENABLE_MANPAGE=no' but conanfile.py correctly uses 'ENABLE_MAN=no' — the git-crypt Makefile variable is 'ENABLE_MAN', not 'ENABLE_MANPAGE'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md dependency section to 'openssl/3.5.6' and build command example to 'make ENABLE_MAN=no' to match the actual conanfile.py.
